#{A dynamic memory-frequency hybrid guided local search that identifies high-utility stagnation edges and applies super-linear penalties scaled by historical usage frequency and relative edge prominence to decisively shatter cycling.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    # Compute edge utilities normalized by historical appearance frequency
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    
    # Adaptive threshold selecting edges near maximal utility
    threshold = 0.95 * max_utility
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_lengths = tour_lengths[selected_mask]
    sel_counts = tour_counts[selected_mask]
    
    # Dynamic super-linear penalty scaling based on chronic recurrence
    # Scaled by local edge length and super-linear frequency factor (1 + count)^1.25
    avg_length = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    relative_prominence = sel_lengths / (avg_length + 1e-8)
    frequency_factor = np.power(1.0 + sel_counts, 1.25)
    
    adaptive_penalties = 0.15 * avg_length * relative_prominence * frequency_factor
    
    # Apply symmetric penalties via vectorized indexing
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += adaptive_penalties
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += adaptive_penalties
    
    return updated_edge_distance
